rawCommits.body:

also forwarded the raw user message over the parent command channel and
omitted it from the request's conversation history. This made the
synthesizer parent run a spurious single-model turn ahead of the
council, with the real member fan-out + synthesis queuing behind it.

contract:
- Append the new user message to the Council request's
  conversation_messages so latest_user_query resolves to the actual
  question (members answer the right prompt).
- Open council cold-opens via a new open-only SessionBridge::open so the
  parent run executes only the orchestrator-injected synthesis turn.

open-only path forwards no UserMessage.

entries.title: Live subagent threads, forced upgrades, and the Plans sidekick
entries.summary: The day's longest stretch: subagents grew from clickable cards to a fully promptable, persisted slide-over; a forced-upgrade gate landed for stale desktop builds; the Sidekick got Plans grouping, a Context bucket viewer, and unified Run rows; and AURA Council got its protocol and runtime foundation.

items.text: Added a hard-blocking forced-upgrade overlay on Desktop that gates the app when the running build is 3+ releases behind its channel, derived from the GitHub Releases list and gated to native builds so web/mobile/dev are unaffected.

Shipped live subagent threads end-to-end: harness protocol additions for SubagentSpawned/SubagentStatus, clickable task cards, a live-streaming modal, history rehydration so reopened cards work, and finally a chat-within-a-chat that reuses the main ChatPanel pipeline for persistence and scroll behavior.

Replaced the subagent modal with an iOS-style inline slide-over inside ChatPanel and made child threads promptable via a new POST /api/streams/subagents/:child_run_id/send endpoint; the parent thread stays mounted as a base layer so open/close animates without resizing.
Subagent transcripts are now persisted as dedicated aura-storage sessions, so a reopened thread reloads its full history instead of vanishing once the live child run is reaped.
Granted SpawnAgent + ReadAgent to project/instance chat agents so any chat agent can fan a turn out into subagents, not just the full-access CEO agent.

Landed the AURA Council foundation: RuntimeRequestType::Council and CouncilMember protocol types, a chat-route council body that resolves N members through the existing model path, and SwarmHarness::attach_run so council members on remote agents can stream to web/mobile.
Added a per-streamKey council count + per-slot model store and a Council count flyout on the model menu that renders N model-picker slots in the input bar.

Renamed the Specs sidekick to Plans and grouped specs under collapsible plan parents, with a ReviewPlanCard surfaced in chat when a plan run completes and a generated per-plan summary rendered as markdown.

Built the Context Composition bucket viewer: a new protocol shape and lazy /context-contents endpoint, a frontend API + cache store, and clickable popover rows that open the bucket's rendered text in the Sidekick preview.

Unified the Sidekick Run pane with the Tasks/Specs Explorer: shared SidekickCollapsibleRow primitive, inline PanelSearch row, and a floating bottom control pill carrying Run/Pause/Stop plus the model picker.

Smoothed transcript behavior: switching Simple/Advanced no longer triggers a cold reveal on the destination surface, scrollbar drags during streaming stop fighting auto-tail, and stream-dropped turns render their content normally with only the warning banner around the recovery actions.
Mapped harness /v1/run 404s and other non-2xx responses to a clear 502 explaining the harness is unreachable or incompatible, with the resolved base URL logged for operator diagnosis.

Polished the public marketing surface: looping typewriter tagline on the hero (kept on one line), faded-in agents hero video, instant nav hover, theme-aware AURA logo hover, and an animated mobile chat mock with per-phone accents and a typing compose bar.
Enforced remote-only web agents end-to-end, with create/update validation, runtime gating, and bootstrap path fixes.

Routed project_info into dev-loop/automaton runs so autonomous turns render the same <project_context> as chat, and removed the silently-dropped SessionConfig.system_prompt field in favor of agent_system_prompt.
Animated the Sidekick active-section label inline next to its icon and dropped the duplicate New terminal/browser "+" buttons that the InstanceTabs strip already provides.
Fixed the changelog card to show 0 commits this month across the PST month rollover instead of a dash, mirroring the existing "releases this month" behavior.

entries.title: AURA Council ships end-to-end with shareable assistant messages
entries.summary: Council fan-out now renders as a live multi-column CouncilPanel, every assistant reply gets a Copy/Share/Reload/More action row backed by a new public share API, and Desktop picked up an in-app screen-recorded /record_demo command.

items.text: Wired AURA Council through the chat request path: council models ride in the chat body, project/instance chat resolves them into SessionConfig.council, the synthesizer turn runs via an open-only SessionBridge so it no longer races a duplicate single-model turn, and the persisted council member set is rehydrated on reload.

Added a CouncilPanel that groups council member spawns into a single tool-call entry with N live columns ordered by council_index, each driving its own subagent stream and opening into the existing slide-over.

Added a Copy/Share/Reload/More action row beneath every completed assistant message; Share creates a public session share and copies a link with a Link2->Check toggle, Reload regenerates the turn via the existing send path, and More opens a metadata popover.

Stood up the public session-share backend (is_public + public_share_id on sessions, authenticated create endpoint, unauthenticated /api/public/share/:token read) and a /s/:token SharedSessionView mounted inside the public marketing shell, with Mixpanel metrics for share link activity.

Added an in-app /record_demo slash command on Desktop that opens a dedicated AURA window, drives a scripted instruction through the real chat UI, and screen-records it to mp4 via ffmpeg, with a preflight that surfaces a native error dialog when ffmpeg is missing.

Made the Context Composition popover collapsible with animated expand/collapse, a single-row "Cached this turn" with an info breakout, stayed open while browsing buckets (including clicks into the Sidekick preview), and aligned bucket row values across rows.
Persisted the /specs/summary model's final assistant text onto the project shadow so generated plan summaries actually show up in the UI instead of always rendering "No summary yet."
Split session-history into finer date buckets (Today, Yesterday, per-weekday for 2-6 days ago, Previous Week, then month/year) across both the Agent and Project lists.

Surfaced submitted appVersion in the admin feedback details panel and tightened shell chrome: a single 1px panel divider, removed the desktop sidekick sliver, and a centered Simple/Advanced sliding pill.

Smaller polish: Background modal now shows only the active theme's section, custom token rows render a single real color swatch, the Sidekick tab overflow calculation no longer mis-collapses icons based on the active tab's expanded width, and the Log tab gained a ClipboardClock glyph.
